docs.text: ardur-server binds to port 8080 by default; set ARDUR_PORT to override the listen port.
Legacy note: ardur-server listened on port 9090 before the 8080 change.
Hybrid retrieval fuses dense embedding results and BM25 lexical results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion at k equals 60, per Cormack 2009.
crates/bm25-index/src/lib.rs implements the Bm25Index type over a Tantivy inverted index for lexical search.
crates/embeddings/src/lib.rs defines the Embedder trait, the FastEmbedEmbedder, and the deterministic MockEmbedder used in tests.
Decision: attention_score is stored as a milli-attention u64 integer so cost receipts stay byte-stable and the tuple keeps Eq for exact ledger math.
The Anthropic and OpenAI providers support SSE token streaming; the Ollama provider streams NDJSON chunks.
The Codex and Claude CLI subprocess providers do not support token streaming; they return the full completion at once.
Before the 2026-06 memory migration, a RecordId was a plain string identifier assigned by the caller.
After the 2026-06 memory migration, a RecordId wraps a time-ordered UUIDv7 minted by the store.
A cap-token is a Biscuit; its jti is a UUIDv4 exposed as VerifiedClaims.token_id and receipted as the cap_token_id.
provider-codex retries the subprocess spawn on ETXTBSY, the Text file busy error, up to five times to dodge an inherited-fd fork exec race.
The CLI renders assistant markdown with comrak and syntect syntax highlighting under the default night theme.
Inbound Slack webhooks route through the messaging-gateway into the FusedRuntime and the reply is posted back to Slack.
